narrow.only_reason: [CREDENTIAL_ALLOCATION_READER_SCOPE] The credential allocation reader reads only standing-grant records under active/shared/runtime/grants/confidential/<tenant>/ (and governed catalogs); it writes nothing.

[CREDENTIAL_ALLOCATION_STORE_SCOPE] The credential allocation store writes only standing-grant records (GRT-<date>-<id>.json) and pending-effect markers (.pending-<id>.json) under active/shared/runtime/grants/confidential/<tenant>/.

[CREDENTIAL_PROBE_STORE_SCOPE] The credential probe reads mission state and writes API-verification proof records (*.json) under active/shared/runtime/health/api-verification/confidential/<tenant>/, plus work-coordination items, locks and scratch for the diagnostic work item it claims.
[SECRET_VAULT_STORE_SCOPE] The secret vault store touches only vault/secrets/*.json (secrets, file-secrets, keychain-registry) and its directory chain.
[PERSONAL_CONNECTIONS_STORE_SCOPE] The personal connections store touches only knowledge/personal/connections/<service>.json documents and their .bak byte-copies.

[DECISION_LEDGER_STORE_SCOPE] The decision ledger touches only the bound tenant's knowledge/confidential/<tenant>/decisions/ (cases, agendas, invites, receipts, concepts, _templates, _reports, consumer locks) and customers/ subtrees, their directory chain, decision-* schemas, knowledge/product reads, the runtime locks directory, and test-seeded case dirs under tmp/vitest-live (--dir is a test-only surface).

[INGEST_KNOWLEDGE_STORE_SCOPE] The ingest commit store touches only the bound tenant's knowledge/confidential/<tenant>/ subtree (cards + _ledger/assets.jsonl), knowledge/public/ingest/ for steward-approved public landings, ingest-* schemas, and test fixture roots under tmp/vitest-live.

[DOT_LIFECYCLE_RUNTIME_SCOPE] The lifecycle runtime store writes only the lifecycle audit ledger, dot event-continuation state and activation heartbeats
[ENV_SETUP_RECEIPT_STORE_SCOPE] The env setup receipt store writes only env-setup-receipt.<manifest>.json files
[BROWSER_COOKIE_STORE_SCOPE] The browser cookie store writes only <account_slug>.json files
